title: SEAI-P-002 Behavioral Event Log Entry
description: Schema for identity-related behavioral events collected during continuous identity verification in SEAI agents.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the AI agent. Must match the agent_id in the birth certificate and P-001 attestation.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event log entry.

drift_score.description: Normalized behavioral deviation score (0 = identical to baseline, 1 = maximum deviation).

drift_threshold.description: Configured drift threshold for this deployment.

fingerprint_hash.description: Hash of the behavioral fingerprint observed at this event. Format is implementation-defined.

metadata.description: Implementation-specific metadata. Must not contain sensitive training data.
